classifications.DISTINCT_STATE_TRANSITION: materially different accepted bounded state transition
classifications.EXACT_REPLAY: same accepted source and same transition from the same pre-state
classifications.EXPECTED_BLOCK: planned rejected row that remains visible in the denominator
classifications.STATE_EQUIVALENT_DUPLICATE: different ids but same normalized transition and materially identical source lineage

classifications.VALID_REPEATED_RENDER_CONTROL: explicit repeated synthesis control with no new state write
